name: legacy-orbit-paper-recipe-transfer-v0
description: Transfer the published ORBIT Q/K optimizer recipe into the frozen ORBIT-all dense confirmation harness. This is a same-harness generational baseline, not an exact reproduction of the historical ORBIT paper model/data stack.

interpretation.orbit_paper_recipe_vs_muon: Published ORBIT recipe transferred into the current frozen harness.
interpretation.orbit_qk_vs_orbit_paper_recipe: Effect of retuning the Q/K-only generation inside the current shared search protocol.
interpretation.orbit_all_vs_orbit_qk: Increment from extending function-aware geometry beyond Q/K under the current matched recipe.
interpretation.orbit_all_vs_orbit_paper_recipe: Total same-harness generational improvement from the published ORBIT recipe to ORBIT-all.
